main.description: System user and group under which the service runs for privilege separation, plus statefile location for UID tracking. Required by pullimap(1).

main.statefile.description: State file to track mailbox UIDVALIDITY and UIDNEXT values. Relative paths start from $XDG_DATA_HOME/pullimap or ~/.local/share/pullimap.

imap.description: Connection and authentication details for the source IMAP server.

imap.host.description: IMAP server hostname or IP address. Can optionally be enclosed in square brackets to force IP literal interpretation.

imap.port.description: IMAP server port (143 for non-SSL, 993 for SSL).

imap.ssl.description: Enable SSL/TLS for the IMAP connection (equivalent to type=imaps).

imap.mailbox.description: IMAP mailbox name to pull messages from (UTF-7 encoded and unquoted).

imap.username.description: IMAP login username (often full email address).

imap.password.description: IMAP login password (store securely in production — e.g., via secrets manager or file permissions).

imap.fetch_batch_size.description: Number of messages to fetch per IMAP batch to avoid timeouts.

imap.auth.description: Space-separated list of preferred authentication mechanisms (PLAIN, LOGIN, etc.).

imap.compress.description: Use the IMAP COMPRESS extension if advertised by the server.

delivery.description: Delivery method: either SMTP (multiple servers supported) or LMTP (single socket).

delivery.smtp_servers.description: List of SMTP relay servers (host and port).

delivery.lmtp_socket.description: Path to LMTP Unix socket (only used if method=lmtp).

delivery.ehlo.description: Name to use in EHLO/LHLO commands.

delivery.recipient.description: Message recipient. If empty, defaults to the username associated with the effective user ID.

tls.description: Optional client-side TLS for outbound SMTP/LMTP connections, plus IMAP-side SSL/TLS settings.

tls.enable.description: Enable TLS for outgoing SMTP/LMTP connections.

tls.ca_file.description: Path to CA certificate bundle for verifying the SMTP/LMTP server certificate.

tls.SSL_verify.description: Whether to verify the server certificate chain and match its SAN/CN against host.

tls.SSL_CAfile.description: File containing trusted certificates for server verification.

tls.SSL_CApath.description: Directory to use for server certificate verification (must be in hash format).

tls.SSL_hostname.description: Name to use for TLS SNI (Server Name Indication). Empty string disables SNI.

tls.SSL_fingerprint.description: Space-separated list of acceptable fingerprints for server certificate SPKI (e.g., sha256$<hex>).

tls.SSL_protocol_min.description: Minimum SSL/TLS protocol version (e.g., TLSv1.2, TLSv1.3).

tls.SSL_protocol_max.description: Maximum SSL/TLS protocol version (e.g., TLSv1.2, TLSv1.3).

logging.description: Verbosity, syslog facility, and optional file log target.

logging.level.description: Minimum log level: debug, info, warn, error.

logging.log_file.description: Path to file where logs are written (empty = no file logging).

limits.description: Resource and rate limits to prevent overload.

limits.max_concurrent_jobs.description: Maximum parallel message deliveries at once.

limits.max_message_size.description: Largest message size (in bytes) to process. 0 = unlimited.

limits.rate_limit_per_minute.description: Maximum messages delivered per minute. 0 = unlimited.

headers.add_received.description: Add a 'Received:' header showing this forwarder's action.

headers.add_date.description: Ensure each message has a Date: header (add if missing).

headers.replace_from.description: If non-empty, overwrite the From: header with this email address.

purge.description: Purge old messages from the IMAP server after a retention period.

purge.retention_days.description: Retention period in days (≥24h accuracy due to IMAP SEARCH). 0 = delete immediately after delivery.
